title: Lessons should be learned before age 30.
content:
Lessons should be learned before age 30.

 

In this blog, we are going to see what are the habits need to follow in routine from the age of 20.

Life balance.

Today most of the people don’t have work life balance, some people do all their work at same time without be worried about the family or health, and some people don’t know how to be concentrate in their work. we should have work life balance; we need to have proper concentration in our work routine and we need to aware how to balance our work life balance in a scale.

We need to have proper balance in between friends, health, family, career.

We should regulate our sleeping pattern to achieve mandatory 6 hours sleep a day. Relax your mind as much you can. proper sleeping pattern help us to prevent from stress and mental related issues.

Calm yourself, Do Meditation, which helps us to have clear thoughts and make our decision-making skills better.

Get familiar yourself to PLAN.

Planning is a key to success.

You can’t be successful ln our life without planning and prioritize the needs.

Prepare “TO DO” list for short-term and long-term goals. Prepare your body to chase that dream.

Don’t worry if something happened beyond our plan, keep a note of it and feel that as a experience to achieve hard things in our life.

 

Time management.

Most important in today modern world. If you a youngster you have billions of seconds left in our life to live, please manage the time efficiently and stay away from the matters that make you to waste your time.

 

Enlarge your friends circle.

You need to have 5 to 10 close friends in your life to share your feelings and thoughts. Without friends, life would be boring and clueless. Contact your friends in regular intervals and have a chill chat with them. Friends will be our light in our dark days so don’t hesitate to be friends with others.

 

The Worst Habits That Age You: What You Should Stop Doing!!!

 

Money.

Know to how to manage and save money in life, without the habit of saving, it is not possible to be a successful man in your later periods in our life.

Get familiar to financial term and learn about financial independence.

Money can’t give you happiness and it will avoid miserable things.

Hobby.

Make yourself familiar to a hobby, sometimes your hobbies turn in to profession life to you. Hobbies helps you to relax your mind and increase your calmness level.

Give your 15 to 30 minutes to hobby in our daily life and practise that in our entire life.

Be persistent. Persistent makes you perfect.

 

You should have 4 P’s in our life to achieve greater things,

 

Persistence

Patience

Perfection.

Power.

Persistence -->Perfection -->Patience -->power.
